svg.data-weight: 22.0 kg (48.6 lbs) for the 7280CR3A-48D6, 7280CR3AM-48D6 and 7280CR3AK-48D6 (guide Table 1); 48.6 lbs (22.04 kg) in the data sheet
svg.data-size-over-ears: 48.3 x 8.8 x 68.4 cm (19 x 3.50 x 27.3 in) with the mounting ears (guide Table 1)
svg.data-power-draw-note: Data sheet: "388 W / 979 W", typical measured at 25 C ambient with 50 percent load on all ports, excluding transceivers. Guide Table 4 reads TBD.
svg.data-storage-temp-datasheet: -40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F), per the data sheet
svg.data-software: EOS; minimum release 4.31.1 per the data sheet
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: each of the 48 QSFP cages runs 100G, or 40G (QSFP+), 50G and 25/10G modes by breakout (data sheet)
svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: each of the 6 QSFP-DD cages runs 400G, or 100G, 50G, 40G and 25/10G modes by breakout (data sheet)
svg.data-optics-osfp: the OSFP-LS port is "for dense 400G-ZR deployment"; the data sheet says the R3A platforms are "optimized to support high power 400ZR OSFP and QSFP-DD optical modules"
svg.data-precision-timing: PTP and SyncE with OCXO and PPS/10M/ToD inputs
svg.data-encryption: none on the 7280CR3A-48D6; all ports (MACsec, IPsec and VXLANsec) on the 7280CR3AM-48D6 and 7280CR3AK-48D6
svg.data-console: RJ-45 serial (RS-232), 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit, no flow control
svg.data-emissions: FCC Class A, ICES-003 Issue 7, EN 55032:2015, VCCI-CISPR 32:2016, AS/NZS CISPR 32:2015

g.data-description: Table 10 - Port LED: off link down; green link up; yellow software disabled; flashing yellow failed diagnostics
g.title: led-port-55

g.data-description: Table 9 - System Status: blinking green powering up; green normal operations; blue the locator function is active; amber two or more fans disconnected or malfunctioning
g.title: led-system

g.data-description: Table 9 - Fan Status: green all fan and power modules operating normally; amber single fan module removed or malfunctioning; red two or more fans disconnected or malfunctioning
g.title: led-fan

g.data-description: Table 9 - PSU Status: green PSU functioning and fully operational; off PSU removed or not operating properly
g.title: led-ps1

g.data-description: Table 9 - PSU Status: green PSU functioning and fully operational; off PSU removed or not operating properly
g.title: led-ps2
